declines.trigger: a query parameter whose JSON value is not a string
declines.description: A server receives every query parameter as text, so a JSON null, boolean, number, array or object has no meaning; the create is refused as misuse (CHS_INVALID_ARGUMENT) and the message names the parameter. Pass the parameter's text as a JSON string.

declines.trigger: an expression that reads the clock or calls a non-deterministic or stateful function
declines.description: A server would evaluate now(), rand() or a server constant with its own values, so no verdict computed here could be trusted; the scan runs after parameter substitution, so a parameter cannot smuggle one in.

declines.trigger: a filter expression that holds a NUL byte
declines.description: The compile reads the expression as a C string, and a NUL would cut it short, which could admit more rows; the create is declined until a counted compile path exists.

declines.trigger: a settings input that is not a JSON object
declines.description: The filter's settings must be a JSON object of string values; any other JSON text is refused as misuse (CHS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, the message names settings) rather than read as no settings.

declines.trigger: an input document (insert_options, filter_options, schema_options) sets a member this build reserves to a value other than its default
declines.description: A reserved member is never ignored, so a caller is told. At a call that answers with a document the decline is the document's (code -2, refused_at call, status CHS_OK); the other calls answer CHS_DECLINED with ch_code 0.

declines.trigger: chs_reference_type with a type this build pairs no widened reference type with
declines.description: The reference type is the widened type a type's values are compared in; a type with none paired is declined rather than answered with a guess.

declines.trigger: a schema compiled under a setting the filter's WHERE cannot honor, from chs_set_defaults, the server profile or the schema's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: A schema compiled under a setting that a server's WHERE would read, and that this build does not apply, has no filter at all, whichever of the defaults, the server profile or the schema's own settings sets it; each name is listed with its layer in the schema description's filter_declined_settings. A filter's own settings are declined at evaluation instead.

declines.trigger: a filter whose session_timezone cannot be attached or under which it does not compile
declines.description: A filter is compiled and evaluated under one session_timezone, as a server analyzes a WHERE per query; where that zone cannot be attached, or the expression does not compile under it, the create (or the evaluation) is declined rather than answered in another zone.

declines.trigger: a call made before chs_initialize, from any call that is valid only after the process setup
declines.description: Every call but the handshake, the frees and the accessors runs under the process setup chs_initialize makes. Before it the call is refused as misuse (CHS_INVALID_ARGUMENT); the message names the call and the setup, and the error carries this id.

declines.trigger: a filter created on a thread that cannot carry a query context
declines.description: A server resolves a WHERE's functions under its query's context, and which function a name resolves to can depend on that context's settings; on a thread that cannot carry one, the create is declined rather than answered under another resolution.

declines.trigger: a column's DEFAULT, MATERIALIZED, ALIAS or EPHEMERAL expression, or a CHECK refused by the access check, calling a function whose resolver needs a server, or a server constant whose analysis at CREATE needs one: its settings, resources, macros or environment
declines.retirement: when the compile runs in a server's environment (its identity, its macros and a query context), for the functions that need only those
declines.description: A server resolves such a function with its own resources, settings, macros or environment, so whether it accepts the schema is its own to say; it is declined, naming the column and the function. Declined although a stock server accepts: serverUUID, the timeSeries functions, getMacro of a configured macro, and on 26.9 getServerPort, filesystemAvailable, filesystemCapacity and filesystemUnreserved.

declines.trigger: a CREATE whose column type, column expression or aggregate function needs a setting that neither the schema's own settings, chs_set_defaults nor the server profile sets and that a stock server's CREATE names when it refuses it at its defaults: a type gate such as allow_suspicious_low_cardinality_types, or an experimental aggregate function's gate; never a codec's setting (allow_suspicious_codecs, allow_experimental_codecs, enable_<family>_codec), which the CREATE applies as the server does
declines.retirement: none: the same CREATE with the setting in the schema's own settings or the server profile compiles
declines.description: A stock server refuses such a CREATE at its defaults, naming the setting, and creates the table under a profile that enables it; a server that already holds the table passed its CREATE under its own profile, so whether the table exists is that server's to say. The decline carries the stock server's code and message. A codec's setting is applied as the server applies it, never declined.

declines.trigger: a higher-order function whose lambda argument is written as a bare function name, such as arrayExists(isNull, arr)
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: A server on these lines rewrites a function name passed where a higher-order function takes a lambda into that lambda, in its analyzer; the filter compile cannot run that step and would refuse the name, so the create is declined and names the function. Write the lambda, such as x -> isNull(x), to get an answer.

declines.trigger: a comparison of a non-String expression with a String constant or {p:String} parameter whose text the server's own index or analyzer reading reads differently from the comparison
declines.description: A comparison reads a String constant once, with cast_string_to_date_time_mode; the server reads the same text again with the default text format in its index analysis, IN sets and analyzer, and drops rows the comparison keeps or refuses a query over a key column. The create is declined, naming the column and both readings; typed parameters and canonical text are answered.

declines.trigger: an AND of two equals comparisons of one expression with different constants that the comparison matches with one value, such as dt = '2024-06-01 12:00:00' AND dt = '1717243200'
declines.description: On the lines whose analyzer folds an AND of two equals over different constants to false whatever the comparison reads, the server returns no row where the comparison keeps one; the create is declined. Constants the server's own constant test calls equal are answered.

declines.trigger: a WHERE that refers to an alias it defines
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: A server expands such a WHERE and checks its expanded size with an analyzer count this build cannot run, so every row is declined; an alias that is defined and never used is answered.

declines.trigger: a filter whose lambdas nest more than 64 deep, each inside the body of the one before
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: A server's planner refuses such a WHERE with 80 (INCORRECT_QUERY) while it builds the WHERE's actions from its analyzer's query tree, a step this build does not run, so every row is declined. A lambda passed as an array argument, outside another lambda's body, adds no depth.

declines.trigger: a filter whose lambdas nest more than 64 deep, each inside the body of the one before
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: A server's planner refuses such a WHERE with 80 (INCORRECT_QUERY) while it builds the WHERE's actions from its analyzer's query tree, a step this build does not run, so no filter is made: chs_filter_create declines it. Where a filter is evaluated row by row (ABI v1), the same limit is lambda-depth, every row declined.

declines.trigger: an if (also written cond ? a : b, in any letter case) whose condition is a constant the rewrite reads: a numeric or NULL literal, or a CAST to UInt8 or Nullable(UInt8), toUInt8, toInt8 or identity of one, a {p:UInt8} query parameter included; a multiIf or CASE, and a condition such as 0 = 1, are not rewritten
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: This build replaces such an if by the branch it takes before typing it; a server's analyzer types it with both, so toTypeName(if(0, [1, 2, 3], s)) is String here and Variant(Array(UInt8), String) there. It also declines ifs both answer alike, such as if(0, 1, n = 1000) and toString(if(0, [1, 2, 3], s)) = 'str_1'.

declines.trigger: a filter that calls indexHint, anywhere in the expression
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: indexHint is 1 on every row it is evaluated on, and the server's answer is the granules its primary-key analysis keeps, which no row-level verdict can reproduce; every row is declined.

declines.trigger: arrayExists over a lambda that compares an element with a constant, where the element or the constant holds a FixedString
declines.description: On the lines where the server rewrites such an arrayExists to has(), and has() compares a FixedString with a String differently from equals(), the server answers differently with the rewrite on and off; every row is declined.

declines.trigger: arrayExists over a lambda that compares an element with a constant, where the element and the constant are different native number types that has() and equals() compare differently
declines.retirement: when 26.7 and 26.8 leave the supported set
declines.description: On the lines where the server rewrites such an arrayExists to has() by default, and has() compares two native numbers with a plain machine comparison, a negative value can match a large unsigned constant or an integer a float; every row is declined.

declines.trigger: a filter that is constant false over the server's empty header because length() of a FixedString or QBit, or a fixed-to-constant CRC, is 0 there
declines.retirement: when 26.3 and 26.7 leave the supported set
declines.description: On the lines where length() of a FixedString or QBit is 0 over the server's empty header, a filter that is constant false there returns no row when the server's WHERE stays a WHERE and the matching rows when the server moves it to PREWHERE; which one runs is the server's plan, so every row is declined.

declines.trigger: a filter that calls CRC32, CRC32IEEE or CRC64 over a FixedString
declines.description: On the lines where a CRC over a FixedString answers every row of a block with the CRC of the block's first row, a batch evaluated as one block gives a row another row's answer; every row of such a filter is declined.

declines.trigger: a filter whose result type the projection pass refuses, over a schema that declares a projection
declines.description: On the lines where the server's projection pass tests the filter's type more strictly than its WHERE does, a table with a projection refuses the query for such a type; this build cannot run that pass, so every row is declined.

declines.trigger: a comparison of a date function of a zone-less DateTime or DateTime64 column with a constant, evaluated in a zone that is not the column's
declines.retirement: when the last declining line leaves the supported set
declines.description: On the lines where the server's preimage rewrite parses the range bounds in the query's zone while the unrewritten comparison reads the column's zone, the server disagrees with itself whenever the zones differ; every row is declined in that case.

declines.trigger: a setting the server's new analyzer or planner reads, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: The setting is read by passes or plan steps that the filter path does not run, so this build cannot apply it as the server does; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: a setting that sets a FormatSettings field the conversion and formatting functions read, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: No measured case shows the filter path applying the field as the server does; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: a setting that a WHERE could read and that no measured case shows this build applying as the server does, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: The safe default for a listed setting without a reviewed classification; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: a setting whose effect goes beyond permitting a function, a type or a form to be named, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: The setting changes a value, a type, a parse, a plan or an evaluation, not only what may be named, and no measured case shows this build applying it as the server does; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: a setting that switches the analyzer or the parser a server runs the query through, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: This build compiles a filter on the old analyzer's expression path only; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: a setting that makes a SELECT return rows chosen by content beyond the WHERE, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: A verdict over the row alone cannot follow a SELECT whose result is chosen by an additional filter or similar; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: a setting that renames aggregate functions to their OrNull form, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: A filter holds no aggregate and no measured case shows this build following the rename; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: a setting that controls projection use in the server's plan, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: The filter path runs no plan; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: the setting that turns the server's preimage rewrite on or off, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: The filter path runs no such pass, and the preimage zone decline covers the lines where the pass matters; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: the setting that makes an alias shadow a column in identifier resolution, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: The server's analyzer resolves the shadowing and this build does not; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings.

declines.trigger: date_time_input_format and cast_string_to_date_time_mode at different values, one of them named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the server's analyzer and its comparison function parse a String constant with the same setting
declines.description: On these lines the server's analyzer parses a comparison chain's String constant with date_time_input_format, while the comparison itself parses it with cast_string_to_date_time_mode; while the two differ the server answers by a parse this build does not make, so every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings. Equal values are honored.

declines.trigger: a compatibility setting that moves a listed setting outside the set the build honors, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the moved setting is honored (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: The compatibility setting rewrites the default of a listed setting that this build does not apply; every row is declined and the message names the moved setting.

declines.trigger: a server-check setting for which this build runs no check, named in the filter's own settings
declines.retirement: when the build runs the check (a reviewed change per setting)
declines.description: A setting the reviewed table classifies as a server check, for which this build has no check to run at create, cannot be applied as the server does; every row is declined and the setting is named in unsupported_settings. No listed setting reaches this today.

declines.trigger: a WHERE whose query exceeds the server's size, depth or AST limits
declines.description: The server's own parser and AST checks run over the smallest query that carries the WHERE, with the parameters substituted; the server's code and message are returned. A caller's own query is longer and meets the limits sooner.

declines.trigger: an expression, or a document the library walks, nested deeper than the calling thread's stack allows
declines.description: Each recursive walk the library itself writes runs the server's own stack check first: once the calling thread has used half its stack, the call is refused with the server's code and message (TOO_DEEP_RECURSION) instead of overflowing the stack. The depth this allows depends on the calling thread's stack size; on a small stack it is less than a server's.

declines.trigger: a CAST or :: to a type the server's default type gates refuse
declines.description: The filter is analyzed under a copy of the context whose type gates are the tree's own defaults, so a suspicious LowCardinality, a large FixedString, similar Variant types or a gated Nullable(Tuple) is refused as a stock server refuses it.

declines.trigger: a LIKE-family constant pattern that ends in an unescaped backslash
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: The server's own pattern conversion refuses such a pattern for the whole query, unless a rewrite to startsWith or endsWith applies on that line; the same conversion runs at create and its error is returned.

declines.trigger: a regular-expression function whose constant pattern is invalid
declines.retirement: when the new-analyzer filter path ships
declines.description: The function runs once at create over one row that holds the haystack type's default; its own exception, from the pattern's compile, refuses the filter.

declines.trigger: a filter whose result type cannot be used as a WHERE
declines.description: A server refuses such a filter for the whole query, before it reads a row; the server's own check runs at create and its code and message are returned.

declines.trigger: a query parameter that is unbound, or whose value does not parse as its declared type
declines.description: The server's own substitution runs before analysis; an unbound name is its UNKNOWN_QUERY_PARAMETER and an unparseable value is its BAD_QUERY_PARAMETER or the serialization's own error.

declines.trigger: an expression the server's analyzer refuses
declines.description: An unknown identifier, an unknown function or a type error is the server's own refusal with its code and message, returned at create.

declines.trigger: a predicate that throws on a row's values
declines.description: A server fails the whole query when its WHERE throws on any row; here the row is an `e` verdict that carries the server's code and message, and a caller enforcing security fails closed on it.

declines.trigger: max_expanded_ast_elements set to 0 at any layer, under which the server refuses every query
declines.description: The server's analyzer checks the size of every node it resolves, so at 0 it refuses every query; the same check runs at create with the value the layers give, and its code and message are returned. A positive value refuses by the query's shape, which this build does not resolve.

declines.trigger: max_temporary_columns at a value the filter's own expression actions exceed
declines.description: The value the layers give is applied to the context the filter's expression actions are built in, so the server's own limit check runs on them at create and its code and message are returned. At 1 the server refuses every query, while a filter over one column is answered here.

declines.trigger: max_temporary_non_const_columns at a value the filter's own expression actions exceed while they run
declines.description: The value the layers give is applied to the context the filter's expression actions are built in, so the server's own limit check runs as they execute; each row is an `e` verdict that carries its code and message.

declines.trigger: a per-call session_timezone the call cannot attach
declines.description: The whole call is unsupported with the setting named, so every row of an attached filter is declined; the rows were read in a context the call did not ask for.

declines.trigger: a process-only chtypes_ setting passed with a call
declines.description: The evaluation-budget and custom-prefix keys are set for the process, not per call; passing one with a call declines the whole call and names it.

declines.trigger: a clock setting whose value is not an integer
declines.description: The clock keys take an integer of nanoseconds; any other value declines the whole call and names the key.

declines.trigger: an INSERT column list that names a MATERIALIZED column
declines.description: A server admits a MATERIALIZED column in the list only under insert_allow_materialized_columns, which this build does not model; the whole call is unsupported and the setting is named.

declines.trigger: a setting the server's parse of the INSERT statement reads, at any layer of the call: max_query_size, max_parser_depth, max_parser_backtracks, max_ast_depth or max_ast_elements stricter than its default as the server's own readers read it, or dialect, implicit_select or allow_settings_after_format_in_insert other than its default
declines.description: A server parses the INSERT statement under these settings before reading the body, and this build sees the body only, so it cannot tell whether a stricter limit or a switched parser refuses that statement: the call is unsupported with the setting named and every filter row is declined. A limit at or above its default is answered, under the call's value.

declines.trigger: a default, server-profile or schema-profile setting that the build fails to apply
declines.description: A setting that passed the checks at the time it was set but fails to apply when a call resolves its settings is recorded as unsupported instead of being dropped; the whole call is declined.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with a filter whose create zone differs from the batch's zone
declines.description: One parse evaluates the attached filter in the batch's zone only, so a pairing with a different create zone is declined; parse the body with chs_block_create and evaluate with chs_filter_eval_block instead.

declines.trigger: a body whose batch outcome is rejected, unsupported or accepted_poisoned
declines.description: A server stores none of a refused body's rows, an unsupported batch is not the server's answer, and a poisoned one stores a value no SELECT reads back; every row is declined and the document's outcome mirrors the batch's.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for, whose batch outcome is rejected, unsupported or accepted_poisoned
declines.description: Only a fully accepted batch exports bytes: the export is declined (export_declined, export_declined_reason this id) and the batch's own code and reason say why. The export's twin of batch-not-accepted.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for, under output_format_json_validate_utf8
declines.description: The setting re-shapes the writer's byte stream outside the frame the export reproduces, so the export is declined and the batch answered.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for, whose column list supplies a MATERIALIZED column (insert_allow_materialized_columns)
declines.description: The export carries the stored columns only, and a re-insert of it would recompute the supplied MATERIALIZED value, so the export is declined and the batch answered.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for, where a stored row lacks a column of the export
declines.description: The export never emits a row with a column silently absent, so the export is declined and the batch answered.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for in a format this build cannot write (only JSONCompactEachRow)
declines.description: The export writer serializes one format; asking for another declines the whole call before any byte is read, answers the batch document with outcome unsupported, code -2 and this reason, and exports nothing.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for, whose listed EPHEMERAL value changes a MATERIALIZED column
declines.description: The export carries no EPHEMERAL column, so a re-insert of it would compute the MATERIALIZED value from the EPHEMERAL column's own expression: the export is declined and the batch answered.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for, whose writer refuses a stored value
declines.description: ClickHouse's own writer refused a value (its code is in export_declined), so the export is declined and the batch answered.

declines.trigger: a body refused on a row whose body view carries the LowCardinality key of a row the error budget skipped before it, read in chunks the INSERT's squashing step would group differently
declines.description: A server checks a body's MATERIALIZED and CHECK expressions over the blocks its squashing step forms, which drop a skipped row's LowCardinality key when its chunk joins a block, so its answer depends on how the body is cut into chunks; the batch is unsupported and every filter verdict over it is declined.

declines.trigger: a JSONEachRow or JSONCompactEachRow body longer than input_format_json_max_object_size, one of whose objects the server's parallel-parsing segmentation engine refuses, where the server parses or may parse the body in parallel
declines.description: The server's JSON segmentation engine refuses an object over the limit with 117 whenever it parses the body in parallel, which its settings or its CPU count decide; the body is declined unless the server's settings make it read the body serially, where the limit is not read.

declines.trigger: a row that cannot be stored: it is rejected, skipped, unsupported or poisoned, or its stored view cannot be built
declines.description: A row that cannot exist in the table has no WHERE truth, and a poisoned value is unreadable by the server itself; the row is declined with its own reason.

declines.trigger: a filter that reads a column whose value in this row the library drew itself from a clock or a generator
declines.description: The library and the server each compute their own clock read or generated value, so a filter that reads such a column has no answer for a row that omitted it; supply the value to get a verdict.

declines.trigger: an evaluation that exceeded the admission memory or wall-clock budget
declines.retirement: retired: replaced by admission-memory-budget and admission-time-budget
declines.description: Retired and never emitted. The one reason for both budgets, when the time budget was wall-clock time: that decline depended on the host's load, and a retry could succeed. Key on admission-memory-budget and admission-time-budget, each of which states whether it depends on load.

declines.trigger: an evaluation of a tenant expression (DEFAULT, MATERIALIZED, CHECK, TTL, index, projection, a Values expression or a filter) that allocates more than the admission memory budget
declines.description: The evaluation's allocations are charged to a thread-private ClickHouse memory tracker capped at chtypes_default_eval_memory_bytes; crossing it unwinds the evaluation. The row is declined; at chs_schema_create, the schema. It does not depend on load: the same input, build and profile declines again, so a retry does not help.

declines.trigger: an evaluation of a tenant expression that spends more of the evaluating thread's CPU time than the admission time budget, or calls sleep
declines.description: Charged to the evaluating thread's CPU time, checked when the evaluation returns; sleep is capped at 1 microsecond per block. CPU time rose up to 1.03x (arm64) and 2.0x (amd64) under load. Over the budget on an idle core: declines on every retry (too expensive, not 503). Under half the budget: never. Between half and the whole: the host's load can decide.

declines.trigger: an input that a process of this build died on at an earlier start, found in the crash-loop breaker's record
declines.retirement: when generation 3's containment answers the first crash too
declines.description: A process of this build died while the library was compiling exactly this input (same call, build, defaults, server profile, text, settings and options), so the library declines it before any vendored code runs and never compiles it again on this host until an operator removes its line from the record; outputs are NULL. A call that is not a hit is answered exactly as without the record.

declines.trigger: a column whose CODEC chain holds an encryption codec (AES_128_GCM_SIV, AES_256_GCM_SIV)
declines.retirement: when the schema is accepted and only its data paths decline
declines.description: An encryption codec's key is read from the server's own configuration when it writes the rows, so a keyed server stores them and an unkeyed one refuses every INSERT; the library holds no keyring, so the schema is declined, naming the column and the codec, and no filter over it can be made. The codec factory decides which codecs encrypt.

declines.trigger: a statement or filter holding a shape that the server of the line being built is known to terminate on (today: on 26.3, a lambda passed as the accumulator, or as any argument after the first, of arrayFold)
declines.retirement: when the shape no longer terminates the server of that line, or the line is retired
declines.description: The build's known-crash list names a shape that a server of this line terminates on. It is found in the parsed statement before any analysis runs, so the create is declined and the shape is never analyzed. The message names the rule, the line, the clause and what to change. 26.7 and later refuse the shape with 43; the rule does not apply there.

declines.trigger: a table engine this build does not model: the Graphite family, whose rollup rules are the server's configuration, or a MergeTree merging mode it does not read; and, under posture load, a CREATE VIEW, CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW or CREATE DICTIONARY statement
declines.description: The engine or the object kind itself is the cause: its behavior comes from something this build does not hold, so the schema is declined rather than modeled. Under posture create a view kind stays CHS_INVALID_ARGUMENT. A decline for anything else in the statement carries its own id.

declines.trigger: a column declared without a type whose type only the server's column description can derive, and that description cannot run here
declines.description: A typeless column takes its type from the expression the server analyses at CREATE; when that analysis cannot run here, or the column's own DEFAULT is declined, the type is unsettled and the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: an INSERT column list on a pre-decoded format (RowBinary, Native, Buffers)
declines.description: The pre-decoded formats address the wire tuple by their own framing rules, and a column list over them is not measured, so the call is declined; pass no list for the no-list shape.

declines.trigger: a Replicated engine in an ATTACH statement, compiled in the CREATE posture
declines.description: A server loads a Replicated table in the ATTACH posture, which differs from the CREATE posture this call compiles in, so the schema is declined rather than modeled in the wrong posture.

declines.trigger: an engine argument that reads the server's macros
declines.description: A stock server has no macros of its own to read, and the server that holds the table has its own, so the argument cannot be evaluated here and the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a MergeTree engine written in the deprecated form that passes ORDER BY and PRIMARY KEY as engine arguments
declines.description: The deprecated engine-argument form is not modeled; write the engine with ORDER BY and PRIMARY KEY clauses.

declines.trigger: an engine whose merge needs the table's columns, which could not be described
declines.description: The engine's merge reads the table's column description; when that description cannot be built the schema is declined rather than guessed.

declines.trigger: an engine argument that is not a plain column name
declines.description: The engine reads the argument as a column of the table; any other expression is not modeled, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a sorting key that names a column the schema does not declare
declines.description: The key cannot be built from a column the schema does not hold, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a table defined by another object: AS table, AS table function or AS SELECT
declines.description: The columns of such a table come from the other object, which this build cannot read; spell the columns out.

declines.trigger: a CREATE clause that changes how the server processes the statement, such as a query-level SETTINGS clause after the storage definition or an SQL SECURITY clause
declines.description: The server applies these clauses to the CREATE itself before it builds the storage, a step this build does not model, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a table that declares two indexes with one name
declines.description: A server refuses the duplicate before the engine's own check, and this build does not model that refusal, so the schema is declined rather than accepted.

declines.trigger: an index of a type this build does not compile in
declines.description: The server registers the index type, and its create-time validation is not modeled here, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a table SETTINGS entry the engine does not take, or a query setting that the server moves into the CREATE's own context
declines.description: The server's handling of the entry depends on a context this build does not model, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a table setting that names the server's storage configuration, such as a storage policy or a disk other than the default
declines.description: The server's storage configuration is not visible to this build, so a setting that names it is declined.

declines.trigger: a column TTL on an engine that does not hold TTLs
declines.description: A server refuses the column TTL for such an engine in a way this build does not model, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a sorting key the server's CREATE would refuse while building
declines.description: The key is built as the server builds it, and the server's refusal is reported as a decline here rather than as a rejection.

declines.trigger: a partition key whose expression this build cannot evaluate as the server does
declines.description: The partition key is declined for the reason its own expression carries, so a body's partitioning is not guessed.

declines.trigger: a table TTL that is not the unconditional rows TTL: WHERE, GROUP BY, TO DISK, RECOMPRESS, or no rows TTL at all
declines.description: Only the unconditional rows TTL is modeled; the other kinds are declined.

declines.trigger: a column TTL that reads a column whose DEFAULT is declined
declines.description: The TTL's value depends on the declined DEFAULT, so it is declined with it.

declines.trigger: a TTL on a schema whose server runs in a time zone this build cannot apply
declines.description: The TTL is evaluated in the server's zone, which this build cannot arm, so the TTL is declined.

declines.trigger: a schema whose server zone (the server profile's session_timezone when it sets one, else its timezone) this build cannot compile in; or, under posture load on a server zone other than the image zone, a column type that holds an AggregateFunction together with a DateTime or DateTime64 that has no zone of its own
declines.description: The schema is compiled in the zone the server binds its types to; when that zone cannot be armed the schema is declined. Under posture load a server builds an aggregate's state with no query context while binding a zone-less DateTime to its own zone, and this build cannot do both in one compile, so such a column type is declined rather than bound to another zone.

declines.trigger: a projection declared WITH SETTINGS
declines.description: The server checks these settings against its MergeTree settings and merge pools, which this build does not model, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a projection that reads a column the table does not store, such as a virtual column or a subcolumn
declines.description: The block the server's writer hands such a projection is not modeled, so the schema is declined.

declines.trigger: a schema whose MATERIALIZED columns cannot be filled for a step
declines.description: The step needs every MATERIALIZED value, and one could not be computed here, so it is declined.

declines.trigger: a column type, or a type text, from a family that needs a live server context
declines.description: Such a type cannot be built without a server context, so the schema or type text is declined.

declines.trigger: a compile mode other than the declared-profile mode 0
declines.description: This build supports one compile mode; any other value is declined.

declines.trigger: a Buffers body whose header has no columns
declines.description: The Buffers reader needs at least one column on the wire, so the call is declined.

declines.trigger: a call whose client clock is further from the batch clock than the configured skew budget
declines.description: Substituting a clock value past the budget would store a timestamp the server would not have written, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: an INSERT column list that is not a JSON array of column-name strings
declines.description: The list cannot be read as names, so the call is declined.

declines.trigger: a constant DEFAULT that cannot be folded under the call's settings
declines.description: The value the server stores depends on the settings the call carries, and the DEFAULT cannot be evaluated under them, so the call is declined.

declines.trigger: an INSERT whose input block has no columns
declines.description: A server refuses the statement before it reads the body, with an empty-column-list error; this build cannot run that step, so the call is declined.

declines.trigger: a single-row call whose input holds no row or more than one
declines.description: A single-row call is handed exactly one row; any other count is declined, and a body of rows is read by the batch call.

declines.trigger: a Values expression whose evaluation runs out of this process's stack
declines.description: A server's answer depends on its own thread's stack, which this process cannot reproduce, so the row is declined.

declines.trigger: a Values expression that contains a subquery
declines.description: Evaluating it would run a query in the gateway process, so the row is declined.

declines.trigger: a Values expression that contains a query parameter
declines.description: Only the server can substitute the parameter, so the row is declined.

declines.trigger: a Values field that could not be scanned or walked for admission
declines.description: An expression the scan never walked must not be evaluated, so the row is declined.

declines.trigger: an INSERT that lists an EPHEMERAL column whose value reaches the TTL
declines.description: The engine's insert-time merge runs before the TTL and this build cannot carry a listed EPHEMERAL value through that merge, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a TTL whose application at merge throws where the server's INSERT stores the row
declines.description: The merge, not the INSERT, meets the error, so what the part holds is declined.

declines.trigger: a Dynamic or JSON value typed by the rows before it, read by a CHECK, DEFAULT or expression
declines.description: The value's stored type depends on earlier rows, so an answer over the row alone would be a guess and is declined.

declines.trigger: a body whose DEFAULT expressions the server evaluates over chunks this build cannot reproduce
declines.description: The server evaluates the DEFAULT expressions over each chunk its reader forms; the chunks could not be read here, so the batch is declined rather than answered per row.

declines.trigger: a DEFAULT expression that throws over a chunk of the body
declines.description: The server's chunk-wise evaluation fails where a per-row one would not, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a body whose server chunks could not be read a second time
declines.description: The block steps re-read the chunks the server forms; when that fails the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a body whose re-read yields a different number of rows than the per-row read stored
declines.description: The stored value depends on the whole block, so a mismatch is declined rather than attributed.

declines.trigger: a body whose chunks the INSERT's squashing step writes as more than one block
declines.description: Each block is its own part and the server commits earlier parts before a later one fails, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a body whose squashed block passes its steps where a row's own view refused
declines.description: The disagreement is not explained here, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a body whose block steps give different answers under the groupings the squashing step can form
declines.description: The answer depends on a grouping this build cannot pin, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a whole-block step that throws where each row passed
declines.description: The block throws on no single row, so the error is not attributed and the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: block steps that were not evaluated to a verdict
declines.description: The steps could not be evaluated here, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a writer step whose sorting-key and skip-index expressions could not be built
declines.description: Without them the writer step has no answer, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: writer index and projection expressions that throw over the body's block and on no stored row alone
declines.description: The error is not attributable to a row, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: writer index and projection expressions that were not evaluated to a verdict
declines.description: The writer step could not be evaluated here, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a body that spans more partitions than the limit and that the server reads in parallel-parsing segments
declines.description: The server's segment block boundaries are not modeled, so the batch is declined rather than answered over blocks that might differ.

declines.trigger: a body read under an error budget that one reader counts over the whole body and parallel segments count per segment
declines.description: The result differs between the two readings, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a body one of whose parallel-parsing segments ends where the library cannot reproduce
declines.description: The server's segmentation is decided by its settings and CPU count, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: a body whose parallel-parsing segments could not be formed here
declines.description: The server counts its error budget over those segments, so the batch is declined.

declines.trigger: an internal consistency check that does not hold: vendored code returned a result the library cannot account for
declines.description: The library declines rather than answer from a result it cannot explain; route the input to the server.

declines.trigger: a filter whose own settings hold a cell of the line's documented-pathological table: a setting at a value under which the server refuses every query
declines.retirement: when the server stops refusing the cell (a reviewed change per cell)
declines.description: The server refuses every query under the cell, so a verdict under it would be unfounded; the create is declined and names the setting. The same cell at the schema or profile layer is listed at tier server-refuses instead.

declines.trigger: a row that leaves to the server a DEFAULT the call defers (insert_options defer_defaults server), read by a CHECK, a key, a skip index, a projection, a TTL, a MATERIALIZED or other DEFAULT expression, or an attached filter
declines.description: The server computes the deferred value on its own INSERT, so whatever reads it in this row has no answer here: the row is declined, and an attached filter's verdict for it is d.

declines.trigger: chs_preview_batch with an export asked for under defer_defaults server, whose exported rows do not all leave the same deferred columns to the server
declines.description: The export has one column list, so a body that supplies a deferred column in some rows and leaves it to the server in others is declined; a body whose rows all supply it, or all leave it, exports.

declines.trigger: under posture load, a stored definition with a projection that does not build, which a server loading the table at startup skips
declines.description: A server that loads a stored definition at startup logs a projection it cannot build and goes on without it, so whether a given server still holds the projection depends on that server's history; the schema is declined. Under posture create the same projection is the CREATE's own refusal, with its code.

declines.trigger: a column whose CODEC chain names a codec family that the server's build registers under a build option and this library's build does not compile in, such as SZ3
declines.retirement: when the library's build compiles the family in
declines.description: The library's codec factory cannot build such a family, so what a server's CREATE answers for it, its own refusal or the table created under the family's setting, is not modeled here; the schema is declined, naming the column and the family, with or without a DEFAULT, under either posture and whatever the codec settings declare.
